title: Xanthe and the Salt
author: J. M. Sandoval
blurb: Ines Eriksen, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
